name: Kidouin Kaon
source:
The only daughter of the Kidouin family, who accepted Shougo to work a part-time for them.
Kaon believe sthat she had been abandoned by her birth mother when she was five years old. This occurrence closed her mind and as a result she became insensitive, indifferent and expressionless, and has never laughed since. 

[Translated from Getchu.]
